top_stories.title: 1Password breached through hijacked employee GitHub account, customer names and emails stolen
top_stories.summary: 1Password suffered a security breach after an attacker hijacked an employee's corporate GitHub account, gaining access to backend systems. The attacker copied customer account records including names and emails, as well as source code from private repositories, with the incident beginning November 19, 2026.

top_stories.title: Microsoft Says Attackers Exploited an Entra Connect Health Flaw and Read Tenant Metadata. Here's What to Ask Your Provider.
top_stories.summary: Microsoft disclosed that attackers exploited a vulnerability in Entra Connect Health, allowing them to read tenant metadata and administrator email addresses. The flaw did not expose passwords or tokens, but the incident involves a core Microsoft Entra (Azure AD) identity infrastructure component used to monitor hybrid identity environments.

top_stories.title: 1Password customer data stolen after employee GitHub account breach
top_stories.summary: 1Password disclosed a data breach in which a corporate GitHub account belonging to an employee was compromised and used to deploy malicious code targeting backend services. The attack resulted in the theft of customer data from the password manager provider.

top_stories.title: In 2027, “the agent did it” stops being an excuse
top_stories.summary: SailPoint's 2027 Identity Security Predictions report highlights a critical gap in AI agent governance, finding that 79% of enterprises have deployed AI agents in production while only 2% have implemented identity security controls for them. The report predicts that by 2027, regulators, boards, and insurers will demand accountability for how organizations govern automated decisions, manage access privileges, and prevent operational disruption from autonomous AI agents.

top_stories.title: 1Password Hacked, Customer Data and Source Code Stolen in GitHub Account Breach
top_stories.summary: 1Password disclosed a security incident in which an attacker gained unauthorized access to its backend systems via a GitHub account breach, stealing some customer data and source code. The company stated that customer password vaults and other secrets were not compromised in the breach.

news.title: Fake paid expert interviews impersonate brands to steal Google logins
news.summary: A phishing campaign called "GoodGuys" is actively targeting corporate users by impersonating major brands including Google, Nvidia, Accenture, and SpaceX to steal Google and Okta credentials. The attack uses fake invitations to paid expert interviews and webinars as the social engineering lure.

news.title: Recap of Microsoft Ignite 2026: Copilot as the Work OS and Agent Governance
news.summary: Microsoft Ignite 2026 featured announcements extending agent identity and governance capabilities across Azure, Entra, and Defender platforms. The event highlighted Copilot positioning as a work operating system with associated identity and cost controls for AI agents.

news.title: Google mandates MCP or CLI access for Workspace AI agents starting February 2027
news.summary: Google has announced that AI agents accessing Google Workspace and Google Cloud will be required to use MCP (Model Context Protocol) or CLI access methods starting February 2027. The security controls are designed to govern how autonomous AI agents authenticate and interact with enterprise data and cloud infrastructure.

news.title: It's a Bot World. We're Just Living in It
news.summary: The article argues that bot detection has become ineffective as a security strategy. It advocates for applying privileged access management principles equally to human users and automated machine/bot identities as an alternative control mechanism.

news.title: Credential Remediation Is Slow When You Don’t Know What Will Break
news.summary: GitGuardian's State of Secrets Sprawl 2026 report found that over 64% of valid secrets discovered in 2022 remained active in January 2026, due to teams' hesitation over potential disruption from revoking credentials. The report highlights that validity-only triage methods miss 46% of critical secrets, recommending impact-based prioritization that considers what a credential can access and whether it was publicly exposed.

news.title: Com-Affiliated Hackers Hijack Cloud Accounts via Vishing for Data Theft and Extortion
news.summary: Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 has disclosed it is tracking numerous waves of vishing (voice phishing) attacks by Com-affiliated threat actors since August 2026 that result in cloud account hijacking, data theft, and extortion. The attacks target financial services, healthcare, legal services, construction companies across the U.S., U.K., and Australia, with the threat actors using social engineering to compromise cloud account credentials and access.

news.title: Attacker used 1Password employee’s GitHub account to copy customer records
news.summary: 1Password disclosed a security incident in which an attacker accessed a corporate GitHub account belonging to an employee and copied customer account records. The breach affected a subset of customers, with the attacker gaining access through the employee's GitHub credentials.

news.title: Secure agentic access to AWS with Enterprise-Managed Authorization
news.summary: AWS Sign-In is introducing Enterprise-Managed Authorization (EMA) using the Identity Assertion JWT Authorization Grant (ID-JAG) to authorize AI agents accessing AWS MCP Server. The feature integrates with existing enterprise identity systems to provide secure agentic access control within AWS environments.

news.title: What defenders need to know about ARTEX, the agentic AI framework threat actors abuse
news.summary: The AI-powered penetration testing framework ARTEX is being abused by multiple threat actor groups including Storm-0940, Storm-3358, Onyx Sleet, Pearl Sleet, Crystal Typhoon, and Salt Typhoon. These actors are using ARTEX to accelerate network reconnaissance and credential attacks, posing direct threats to authentication and access control systems.

news.title: Planning for 99.99 percent availability with the Amazon Cognito Plus feature plan
news.summary: Amazon Cognito has introduced a Plus feature plan designed to support 99.99% availability for sign-in and access control workloads. The plan covers managed user directories, social and enterprise federation, and passwordless authentication methods including passkeys and one-time passwords.

news.title: AWS IAM extends trusted identity propagation to IAM federation and IAM Roles Anywhere, and simplifies it in IAM Identity Center
news.summary: AWS has extended trusted identity propagation (TIP) to IAM federation and IAM Roles Anywhere, while also simplifying its implementation in IAM Identity Center. TIP carries human user or workload identity with requests to supported AWS services, enabling its use in IAM policy conditions for access control and originating identity tracking.

news.title: VMware vCenter Hit by Another Critical 9.8-Rated Auth Bypass Flaw After Zero-Day Exploitation
news.summary: Broadcom has patched a critical authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-123903, CVSS 9.8) in VMware vCenter's Directory Service (vmdir), along with 22 other flaws affecting VMware ESX, Workstation, Fusion, and Avi Load Balancer. The flaw allows a malicious actor to bypass authentication, following prior zero-day exploitation of similar vulnerabilities in VMware products.

news.title: Okta Links ShinyHunters-Associated Vishing Group to New INCEPTION Data Leak Site
news.summary: Okta's Threat Intelligence team has linked a threat cluster (O-UNC-053) affiliated with ShinyHunters to a rebranded extortion operation called INCEPTION. The group is known for using vishing attacks to steal credentials through phishing pages and MFA approval manipulation.

news.title: Microsoft Fixes Azure API Management Classic Flaw as Actor Targets Customer Secrets
news.summary: Norway's NSM disclosed a vulnerability in Microsoft Azure API Management (APIM) that an unknown threat actor exploited to target access tokens, secrets, and named values across multiple Norwegian businesses. Affected organizations include energy companies Equinor and Skagerak Energi, with Microsoft issuing a fix for the classic flaw.

news.title: New Inception extortion gang launches large-scale vishing campaign
news.summary: A new data extortion group called 'Inception' has launched a large-scale vishing (voice phishing) campaign targeting single sign-on (SSO) credentials across multiple global organizations. The campaign focuses on compromising SSO credentials as an entry point for data extortion operations.

news.title: Delegate user access to AI agents with Amazon Cognito token exchange
news.summary: Amazon Cognito is introducing a token exchange capability that enables delegated user access to AI agents using OAuth 2.0. The feature allows applications to request scoped tokens on behalf of users to authorize AI agent actions, extending identity delegation patterns to agentic AI workflows.

news.title: New Inception Extortion Brand Tied to SSO Vishing Campaign
news.summary: A new extortion group called Inception has been linked to an SSO vishing campaign targeting employee credentials. Okta and ReversingLabs collaborated to attribute the campaign to Inception, which uses social engineering voice calls to compromise SSO access.

news.title: How Companies Verify the Human Behind an AI Agent
news.summary: The article addresses the challenge of verifying human identity and ownership behind AI agents for authorization purposes. It distinguishes between authenticating who owns an AI agent versus authorizing what actions that agent is permitted to perform, such as modifying customer records.

news.title: ShinyHunters-linked crew resurfaces on new leak site
news.summary: Okta's threat intelligence team discovered that a crew linked to the ShinyHunters leak site has resurfaced under the name "Inception" after the original site went dark in September. Okta tracks the crew as O-UNC-053 and has been monitoring their activity as part of its threat intelligence operations.

news.title: Know the identity behind the role: Authorize and audit with trusted identity propagation
news.summary: AWS has introduced trusted identity propagation, a new capability that makes it easier to grant access and audit activity based on the specific user or workload behind an AWS IAM role. The feature allows organizations to authorize and audit at the individual identity level rather than the role level, providing more granular visibility into who or what is performing actions within AWS environments.

news.title: CrowdStrike Makes AI Security Push With Blockbuster Zscaler Deal
news.summary: CrowdStrike is reportedly pursuing a $44 billion acquisition of Zscaler to combine endpoint protection with zero-trust network security. The deal would unite two major cybersecurity platforms, with a focus on securing AI agents through integrated zero-trust capabilities.

news.title: How Security Vendors Are Tackling Access-Control Challenges for AI Agents
news.summary: Security vendors are developing converging approaches across identity, runtime, and development controls to address access-control challenges posed by AI agents in enterprise environments. CISOs must evaluate differing vendor strategies for keeping AI agents within their assigned authorization boundaries.

news.title: Microsoft Fixes Nearly 1,100 Security Vulnerabilities
news.summary: Microsoft released a Patch Tuesday update addressing nearly 1,100 security vulnerabilities, including 63 critical flaws. The update includes a zero-day vulnerability in Microsoft Outlook among the patched issues.
